title: Case Prompting to Mitigate Large Language Model Bias for ICU Mortality Prediction
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on measuring performance disparities and biases in ICU mortality prediction based on demographic attributes such as sex, age, and race.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The analysis is exclusively focused on biases associated with sex, age, and race in a clinical prediction context.
